# TelegramGeeks Pro — Comprehensive Platform Index (llms-full.txt)

TelegramGeeks Pro is the industry standard for scalable Telegram marketing, account lifecycle management, audience extraction, and AI-driven conversational outreach.

## 77 Automation Modules Reference

### 1. Account Operations
- `converter`: High-speed session to TData converter.
- `two_way_converter`: Bidirectional conversion between Telegram Desktop TData folders and Telethon/Pyrogram SQLite sessions.
- `booster`: 30-day progressive algorithmic warming engine mimicking human behavior.
- `registrar`: Multi-threaded SMS account registrar supporting 25+ SMS services.
- `duplicator`: Clones and exports secondary sessions with independent hardware keys.
- `json_generator`: Generates random realistic Android/iOS/Desktop device fingerprints.
- `spambot_remover`: Automated appeal dispatcher to @SpamBot for lifting temporary blocks.
- `manager`: Batch profile updater (avatars, 2FA passwords, bio, usernames, privacy settings).
- `number_checker`: Phone number validation against Telegram user database.
- `tdata_checker`: Session validity and freeze verification engine.
- `auth_key_cleaner`: Session revocation and active session termination tool.
- `session_fixer`: Automated repair for corrupted SQLite session headers.
- `account_stats`: Live account balance, subscription, and limitation telemetry.
- `account_cleanup`: Auto-leave unused groups and purge dialogue history.
- `profile_sync`: Multi-account avatar and metadata bulk synchronization.
- `bulk_logout`: Graceful session revocation across distributed clusters.

### 2. Audience & Parsing
- `scraper`: Fast member extraction from public/private Telegram supergroups.
- `active_filter`: Real-time filtering by user online status (recently, this week, active).
- `comment_parser`: Scrapes commenters and discussion participants under channel broadcasts.
- `global_search`: Keyword-based discovery for global Telegram channels and public groups.
- `hidden_parser`: Extract members through message reactions, polls, and comment history.
- `geo_search`: Location-based proximity member search via Telegram NearBy API.
- `phone_parser`: Extract contacts and cross-match phone databases.
- `invite_link_collector`: Auto-discover Telegram invite links across web and social platforms.
- `admin_finder`: Identify owners and administrators of target groups.
- `user_info_enricher`: Scrapes bio, creation date estimate, and verified badge indicators.
- `group_analytics`: Group activity metrics, message frequency, and active hours distribution.
- `story_viewer`: Auto-view user stories to generate inbound curiosity traffic.
- `topic_parser`: Sub-forum and forum topic thread scraper.
- `silent_collector`: Passive packet-level member interception.
- `duplicate_cleaner`: Deduplicate target user lists across multiple campaigns.

### 3. Messaging & Outreach
- `mass_dm`: Multi-threaded direct message sender with spintax and dynamic delays.
- `inviter`: Bulk group member inviter with rate limit throttling and admin bypass.
- `forwarder`: Automated cross-posting and message mirroring between channels.
- `secret_chat_dm`: High-security end-to-end encrypted secret chat outreach.
- `story_reaction`: Automated emoji reaction sender for Telegram stories.
- `poll_booster`: Automated vote casting on channel surveys and polls.
- `reaction_booster`: Automated emoji reaction booster for channel broadcasts.
- `chat_warmer`: Simulated organic dialogue and mutual chat exchange between account clusters.
- `voice_dm`: Automated voice note dispatcher.
- `video_note_dm`: Automated circular video note message sender.
- `premium_gift_sender`: Bulk giveaway and Telegram Premium gift automation.
- `scheduled_broadcaster`: Timed announcement scheduler with queue management.
- `draft_broadcaster`: Bulk cloud draft injector across managed accounts.
- `report_engine`: Mass reporting automation against infringing or competitor assets.
- `mass_mention`: Tag target users in group discussions with targeted offers.
- `button_message_sender`: Inline URL and callback button message sender.

### 4. AI Personas & Neuro-Text
- `persona_orchestrator`: AI multi-agent dialogue manager with dynamic contextual memory.
- `neuro_text`: LLM-based text spinner and paraphrasing engine for zero-pattern outreach.
- `soul_prompts`: Deep personality, temperament, and goal configuration for worker bots.
- `context_memory`: Episodic conversation retrieval across multi-day user dialogues.
- `auto_responder`: Autonomous 24/7 lead qualifier and objection handler.
- `translator`: Real-time bidirectional message translation in 45+ languages.
- `sentiment_analyzer`: Real-time mood and intent detection on incoming leads.
- `lead_tagger`: Auto-qualify and categorize leads into CRM stages.
- `objection_handler`: Semantic response selection for pricing, trust, and tech inquiries.
- `voice_synthesis`: AI voice cloning and natural speech message creation.
- `avatar_generator`: AI realistic portrait generator for profile photos.
- `bio_synthesizer`: Natural persona bio and username generator.

### 5. Infrastructure & Operations
- `proxy_manager`: SOCKS5/HTTP/IPv6 proxy pool manager with auto-rotation.
- `proxy_tester`: Latency, fraud score, and IP geolocation verification tool.
- `sms_dashboard`: Live balance check and API key manager for 25+ SMS vendors.
- `flood_analyzer`: Real-time tracking of Telegram API flood wait countdowns.
- `cloud_storage`: Secure remote backup of session databases.
- `dpapi_vault`: Hardware-level Windows credential encryption.
- `device_emulation`: Realistic hardware profiles (GPU, RAM, OS build, CPU cores).
- `ip_geolocation`: Geo-match proxy IP with account registration country.
- `multi_threading`: Asynchronous concurrent event loop manager.
- `task_scheduler`: Cron-style recurring automation workflow runner.
- `webhook_dispatcher`: Real-time HTTP notifications for incoming leads and alerts.
- `traffic_balancer`: Workload distribution across multiple server instances.
- `anomaly_detector`: Early warning system for account degradation signals.
- `license_validator`: Hardware-bound offline activation key manager.
- `audit_logger`: Immutable action history and compliance logs.
